review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.decision: Proceed with a complete phone job and two tablet shards after reviewing the measured cost and rerun evidence
review.notes: Reviewed the device profiles, one QA producer, independent phone completion, and disjoint tablet coverage against workflow 45020309125 and formal PR run 45024039846. Verified the 90-day repository maximum and 30-day provider rerun window. Only small tablet receipts receive longer retention. No branch rule or release work is part of this candidate.

cases.description: Keep the original phone and tablet delivery checks with one QA producer, a complete phone run and two tablet shards
cases.setup: Inspect the repository workflow, change selection and aggregate verdict with the Android scope selected and unselected.
cases.action: Check that one named phone job runs the full inventory directly, two tablet shards share the same QA producer, and the original tablet check verifies their receipts.
cases.expected: ci-required still reports all selected Android jobs. The phone and tablet checks keep their original names. An unselected Android scope may skip; any selected failed, cancelled, missing or skipped Android job fails ci-required.

cases.description: Require each case exactly once in the complete phone run and across the tablet shards on the same QA APK
cases.setup: Use the actual Android journey inventory and synthetic lane, APK and outcome receipts for both device profiles.
cases.action: Verify direct phone and paired tablet results, then mutate selection, observed cases, group, run identity and APK evidence.
cases.expected: A complete phone result and disjoint tablet subsets cover every registered case exactly once. Unexpected skip, failure, duplicate, missing file, blocked case, lost automation, wrong identity or APK mismatch fails.

cases.description: Select the actual tablet shard execution from same-run attempts when GitHub copies a retained success
cases.setup: Simulate the checked GitHub failure-only history, including new job IDs and created timestamps on copied successes, while retaining original runner/start/end. Include PR head and tested merge SHA.
cases.action: Resolve the actual execution from the current attempt view and all recorded attempts, then try non-success, ambiguous origin, missing original receipt, duplicate attempt or foreign run or head.
cases.expected: Bind each latest effective success to its unique actual execution attempt. Older successes only qualify when copied from the same runner/start/end and expected run/source. Missing history, newer non-success and conflicting identities fail.

surfaces: GitHub Actions artifact retention and recovery
cases.description: Retain small tablet coverage through the rerun window and explain how to recover unavailable evidence
cases.setup: Inspect the workflow retention declarations and simulate a coverage download failure for either tablet shard.
cases.action: Check the small receipt lifetime and the recovery message for each missing download, leaving the APK and diagnostic budget unchanged.
cases.expected: Retain successful tablet receipts for 35 days and QA APK and diagnostics for seven. An unavailable receipt still fails the summary. A missing receipt requires its producer, and a missing APK requires the native build or the whole workflow.
